correctness.rationale: Direct substitution proves both quartic completed-square forms for every real a,b. Monotonicity in u² gives exact necessary-and-sufficient four-sheet thresholds, all target-window endpoints and widths. Discriminant factorization gives four and two real successors of the same phase-labelled orbit at a=-ε,b=ε; the local Floquet multiplier is -ε^{-2} at both phases, with ab≠0. The cyclic Jacobian 1-ab stays nonzero near the jointly singular point. The embedded exact-rational symbolic checker corroborates polynomial identities and the rational witness; no finite run is used to prove the universal root census.

value.rationale: The model is the minimal pair of quadratic backward steps capable of four-sheet two-step branching, a natural structural test of phase relabeling at a double evolution singularity. The theorem gives complete, sharp necessary-and-sufficient two-parameter inequalities, exact caustic windows and their widths, all four phase-ordered configurations arbitrarily near the double singularity, and an explicit regular same-Floquet/different-branching witness. This shows a genuine limitation of local spectral information for global implicit successor geometry; no general dynamical-stability conclusion is claimed.
